seriesTitle: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: When infamous bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko make a run for the Mexican Border, a pit stop at a liquor store turns into a deadly standoff.

episodes.title: Blood Runs Thick
episodes.summary: As the Gecko Brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit, Richie's visions escalate.

episodes.title: Mistress
episodes.summary: Richie struggles with his visions. Forced to stop at a motel, Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border.

episodes.title: Let's Get Ramblin'
episodes.summary: The Gecko Brothers take the Fuller family hostage and attempt to leave the motel undetected.

episodes.title: Self-Contained
episodes.summary: After a daring escape from the motel, Seth leads the Fuller's RV to the border crossing.

episodes.title: Place of Dead Roads
episodes.summary: The Gecko brothers and the Fuller family enter the Titty Twister and find more than they bargained for, as Seth senses his deal with Carlos may be slipping away.

episodes.title: Pandemonium
episodes.summary: With everyone at odds, the Gecko brothers and the Fuller family are forced to sit down and watch the nightly performance by Santanico Pandemonium.

episodes.title: La Conquista
episodes.summary: As Santanico tries to turn Richie to her cause, Freddie confronts Carlos about his destiny and the temple's mysterious past.

episodes.title: Boxman
episodes.summary: In order to free Santanico, Seth and Richie must face the labyrinth within the temple. Jacob and Kate are forced to confront Scott¹s transformation, while Freddie uncovers a new lead.

episodes.title: The Take
episodes.summary: Seth and Richie defeat the labyrinth only to find they've been double-crossed, leading to a climactic clash with Carlos and Narciso. Meanwhile, the Fullers confront their own demons, and Freddie makes a fateful choice.

episodes.title: Opening Night
episodes.summary: Season 2 begins three months after Santanico fled the strip club with Richie, and now they're plotting revenge outside Houston. Meanwhile, Seth and Kate are on the run in Mexico.

episodes.title: In a Dark Time
episodes.summary: Seth and Kate stage a heist, while Gonzalez endures frightening visions that lead to a grisly discovery, and back at the Twister, Malvado's plans are set into motion by Carlo's emergence from the labyrinth.

episodes.title: Attack of the 50 ft. Sex Machine
episodes.summary: Richie and Santanico go undercover as sex traffickers to gain access to Malvado's food supply; Sonja forces Seth to quit using drugs; Freddie defends his family when Sex Machine comes looking for the codex.

episodes.title: The Best Little Horror House in Texas
Bondage
episodes.summary: Richie and Seth make peace and team up to look for Malvado's headquarters. Meanwhile, Carlos kidnaps Santanico; and Kate tries to save her brother with help from Freddie.

episodes.title: Bizarre Tales
episodes.summary: Freddie and Kate are trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the Lords of the Night, after discovering an epic secret on the trail of the mass grave.

episodes.title: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium
episodes.summary: Uncle Eddie helps Rich and Seth make a plan to complete Santanico's revenge. Meanwhile, Freddie and Kate encounter an unexpected foe following Malvado's attack.

episodes.title: The Last Temptation of Richard Gecko
episodes.summary: Trust is broken and new loyalties form between brothers and partners as the plan for the big job falls into place.

episodes.title: There Will Be Blood
episodes.summary: Seth helps Santanico confront Malvado. Meanwhile, Richie and Kate must stop Carlos and Scott from overturning the ancient prophecy and taking control of a powerful evil.

episodes.title: Santa Sangre
episodes.summary: Seth and Santanico clash with Richie over his betrayal, while Carlos and Scott aim to take Malvado's empire and unleash culebra frenzy on the world.

episodes.title: Head Games
episodes.summary: A new enemy determined to destroy all culebras infiltrates the organization following the Lords' decision to demote Seth and Richie to collector.

episodes.title: La Reina
episodes.summary: Seth and Richie discover that Santanico Pandemonium has been targeted by an ancient queen who's taking on a familiar form. Meanwhile, Freddie and Ximena end up in a confrontation after a trail of massacres leads them to Brasa.

episodes.title: Protect and Serve
episodes.summary: Freddie joins forces with an old enemy in order to destroy a demon who's enslaving culebras. Meanwhile, Seth and Richie track down an ancient hunter.

episodes.title: Fanglorious
episodes.summary: When Amaru puts Scott Fuller in her sights, the Geckos and their team must defend him against Brasa's most lethal fighters yet – Jaguar Warriors from hell.

episodes.title: Shady Glen
episodes.summary: Seth and the team head to a suburban neighborhood after its citizens are attacked by cannibals.

episodes.title: Straitjacket
episodes.summary: Richie calls Seth for help after waking up in an abandoned asylum. Elsewhere, Seth assembles the team in case of a trap; and Amaru unleases a demon like no other.

episodes.title: La Llorona
episodes.summary: The team catches a lucky break against Amaru. But nothing is what it seems, as out heroes fall victim to the seductions – and horrors – of a female Xibalban demon.

episodes.title: Rio Sangre
episodes.summary: Santanico returns with a new secret – and a potential new ally – leading the Geckos to Lord Venganza, who is hiding out in a bloody culebra prison.

episodes.title: Matanzas
episodes.summary: The Gecko brothers follow Amaru to a mysterious Western town, where she plans to reclaim her true form and open the gates of hell.

episodes.title: Dark Side of the Sun
episodes.summary: With Kate Fuller near death, our heroes race against an eclipse to defeat Amaru and close the gates to Xibalba, before hell consumes the world.
